podcast.title: Exceptional Piano Virtuosity
podcast.body: Garth Hudson, a member of The Band, is noted for his extraordinary piano playing ability. Despite appearing frail, his hands would seemingly "come alive" when they touched the keys, allowing him to produce remarkable and intricate music. "He was so frail, yet when his hands touched the keys, wow."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
